title: Dark mode toggle causes page to reload and lose unsaved form data
description:
When a user clicks the dark mode toggle in the top navigation bar while filling in a multi-step form (e.g., onboarding wizard or project settings), the entire page reloads and all unsaved form data is lost.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Start filling out the 'Create New Project' form (3-step wizard)
2. Complete step 1, partially fill step 2
3. Click the dark mode toggle in the top navbar
4. Page reloads, all form data is lost, user is back at step 1

**Expected:** Theme changes without page reload; form data preserved.

**Workaround:** Users can use system-level dark mode. In-app toggle should be avoided during form fills.

**Root cause (hypothesis):** The theme toggle calls `window.location.reload()` instead of updating a CSS class or React context. This is a leftover from the legacy implementation.

**User feedback:**
> 'I filled in the whole onboarding form and lost everything!' — @new-user-slack-report

**Fix suggestion:** Replace `window.location.reload()` with theme context update + localStorage persistence.
